_meta.description: NpcThinkParam gap analysis between vanilla ER and vanilla NR for chrs present in both. Each row indicates ThinkParam rows available in ER but absent in NR. Missing think rows correspond to per-variant AI tuning that selects specific behaviors (breath attacks, ranged options, phase-aware patterns). Sparse NpcThinkParam usually means a chr in NR retains its underlying moveset data but the AI never invokes the full set — chrs report-confirmed in this state include c4770 (Valiant Gargoyle missing poison breath, Alaric v0.28.0).
_meta.methodology: For each c-prefix in NR roster, group ER and NR NpcThinkParam by c-prefix (ID // 10000). Diff ID sets; surface rows in ER not in NR.
